method: Area-weighted raster-center assignment, using sample areas in EPSG:6933. Not exact pixel-polygon intersection.
shared_tile_edges: Southern and eastern raster posts excluded to avoid duplicate boundary samples.
notes: Elevations are land-only, in meters relative to EGM96.
Slope statistics are land-only and measured in degrees.
Water fraction uses classified NASADEM sample coverage.
Missing tiles or water-only locations are not zero elevation.
5 km is the analysis grid, not the source DEM resolution.
geometric_coverage_method: Exact projected area intersection with available NASADEM tile footprints in EPSG:6933.
source_gap_note: The NASADEM catalog does not include tile n23e066. Uncovered cells remain missing, not water or zero elevation.
sampling_note: Original raster-center sampling estimates may exceed 100%. Those estimates are preserved separately for audit purposes.
